entities.description: Inquisitor who demands Geralf be found and made an example of.

entities.name: Karametra
entities.description: Goddess whose acolytes celebrate spring and whose love shows in verdant fields.

entities.description: Speaker who says a mirror shapes reality.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: Guild that always stands for justice and never alone.

entities.name: General Ferrous Rokiric
entities.description: Boros general who speaks for the Legion.

entities.description: Academy with automated systems sorting acquisitions.

entities.name: Quicksilver Sea
entities.description: Sea over which a thought monitor roams.

entities.name: Rishada
entities.description: Place where work is easy to find if you do not ask questions.

entities.name: Mistmeadow
entities.description: Doun where death matters less than duty.
